threat_event: Prolonged loss of the single CAD instance halts dispatch for the Ambulance division and 14 client agencies
threat_source: Cloud region failure, ransomware, or a failed change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One CAD instance in provider A serves all 4 centers; no standby outside provider A; failover never tested; drills assume a few hours
existing_controls: 35-day point-in-time restore; hourly immutable copies to provider B; manual dispatch binders; cross-center call routing
treatment_plan: Build a warm CAD standby in provider B; test failover twice a year; multi-day manual dispatch drill at every center
owner: Group dispatch and clinical platforms director

threat_event: Ransomware spreads between the CAD and the revenue cycle file transfer servers and steals data from several divisions and clients
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared management subnet in the legacy account; direct peering without hub inspection; outside guardrails
affected_asset_or_process: Legacy account (CAD, integration engine, file transfer servers)
existing_controls: EDR on all servers; 24x7 SOC; immutable backups
treatment_plan: Move the CAD and the file transfer servers into separate landing-zone accounts; remove the shared subnet; east-west monitoring until then

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses regulator, client, county, or investor notice deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Matrix never exercised; two covered entities, about 184 client contracts, and 38 county agreements with different clocks
existing_controls: Group IR plan; disclosure committee charter
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 multi-party matrix; client and county notice register; cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15

threat_event: AI used in dispatch, clinical, and billing decisions without adequate governance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI triage advisory mode started before council review; client callers not covered; other AI use cases at different stages of review
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D4 AI triage module; ePCR narrative drafting; posting model; coding assistant
existing_controls: Group AI Standard (2026-03); Group AI council
treatment_plan: Group AI governance program (P10); conditions on AI-001; inventory and tiering of all use cases

threat_event: Attacker uses the CAD vendor support path to gain CAD administrator access
threat_source: Cybercriminal group or a compromised vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 local, persistent CAD vendor accounts with standing administrator rights over a persistent VPN; passwords unchanged since 2024
existing_controls: Vendor BAA; VPN limited to the legacy account
treatment_plan: Remove standing accounts; vendor access only through group PAM with approval and recording

threat_event: Criminal justice information is held in the CAD without CJIS Security Policy controls
threat_source: Process gap (data received from a county)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Premise notes from a sheriff records system arrived over a CAD-to-CAD feed from 2024-11 to 2026-08-20; status not determined
existing_controls: Field suppressed on 2026-08-20; county asked its CJIS Systems Agency for a determination
treatment_plan: Obtain the determination; purge or segregate the 3,400 premise notes as directed; interface field standard for all 21 feeds

threat_event: Group identity platform compromise or outage affects every division
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All divisions federate to SYS-G1; dispatch consoles depend on it for sign-in
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for administrators; PAM; break-glass accounts tested quarterly
treatment_plan: Extend phishing-resistant MFA to all remote workforce access by 2027-06-30

threat_event: Critical third-party outage or breach affects several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ePCR, EHR, clearinghouse, CAD, and contact-center vendors are each single providers
existing_controls: Annual SOC 2 reviews of tier 1 vendors; BAAs
treatment_plan: Continuous monitoring of tier 1 vendors; second clearinghouse connection (BDS-012)

threat_event: Compromise of fleet devices gives an attacker a path to the CAD or disrupts vehicles fleet-wide
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 2,400 routers outside group configuration management; shared tunnel key; firmware not tracked
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D1 fleet mobile systems; SYS-D4 CAD
treatment_plan: Bring fleet devices under group configuration and vulnerability management; per-device certificates

threat_event: Division standards drift from group policy and staff follow the wrong rules
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Urgent Care supplement last aligned in 2024; no owner or review date
treatment_plan: Re-issue the Urgent Care supplement; annual alignment attestation for every division
owner: Urgent Care security and compliance lead

threat_event: Breach at the 46 acquired clinics goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy practice management and EHR not federated to SYS-G1 and not sent to the SIEM
treatment_plan: Interim log forwarding and weekly access review; migrate to SYS-D2 by 2027-06-30

threat_event: Monitoring blind spots delay detection across divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Radio console gateways, vehicle routers, the legacy clinic system, and east-west traffic in the legacy account are not monitored
treatment_plan: Onboard remaining sources; east-west sensors in the legacy account

threat_event: Workforce members look up CAD history or patient records without a job need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 45,000 users; CAD history search is broad for telecommunicators; shared MDC accounts hide who looked
existing_controls: Role-based access; sanctions procedure; ePCR access reports
treatment_plan: Behavior analytics on CAD history searches; named MDC sign-in

threat_event: Card data captured by the billing contact center is exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agents hear card numbers; recordings paused by hand; never assessed as a service provider for clients
existing_controls: Hosted online payment page; agent background checks
treatment_plan: Keypad entry with tone masking so agents never hear card numbers; purge recordings with card data; service provider assessment

threat_event: A hurricane disables the Florida communications center and many stations at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida center handles the largest call volume; staff are also affected
existing_controls: Generators; cross-center call routing; hurricane plans
treatment_plan: Pre-staged relocation of Florida telecommunicators to other centers; annual hurricane exercise including the CAD
owner: BDS vice president of communications operations

threat_event: The group misstates or files late an SEC cybersecurity disclosure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality decisions depend on fast facts from several divisions
regulatory_driver: SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; Reg S-K Item 106
treatment_plan: Materiality factors worksheet in the P08 runbook; include in the tabletop

threat_event: Data shared with vendors and subcontractors beyond what BAAs and client contracts allow
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI triage processing of client callers; subcontractor flow-down terms not checked for new services
existing_controls: Standard BAAs; legal review of new vendors
treatment_plan: Contract register mapping each vendor to client terms; amend the CAD vendor BAA to cover client agencies

threat_event: Phishing leads to workforce account takeover at scale
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large, mobile workforce with high turnover among field staff
existing_controls: MFA; quarterly phishing exercises; email filtering
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for remote access; targeted training for new field staff
